title: Astrid and the Garden
author: Casper Voss
blurb: Jude Nakamura, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
